title: Transition coherence for a stagewise rational target comparison
statement: After the normalized integral square is localized, conjugation by the rational-left maps and the common-stage pullback transition gives the displayed component equation.

proof.text: Given a stagewise family and transition isomorphisms identified with the canonical field-system comparisons, localize the normalized integral square and conjugate by the rational-left maps and common-stage pullback transition.
